how_to_read: Written by hand after the searches, not produced by a script, and not reproducible by one. The engine does not match identifiers exactly and does not index the contents of large tables, so 'no page mentions the star' is weak evidence. It is recorded so the search is not repeated and so nobody mistakes it for an ADS full-text search, which has not been done.
